expected_behavior: Some pump terminology is relevant, but the complete cooling-tower package is not covered. Review or abstention is defensible; RECOMMEND for the whole package is not.
source_text_for_pdf: Provide an induced-draft cooling-tower package for a process plant: fan assembly, gearbox, drift eliminators, fill media, basin, make-up controls and circulating-water pump set. The pump is one subsystem among multiple separately tested components. Include vibration limits, noise report and site acceptance plan.
